# Jermaine's Home Services

> Full-service home improvement contractor offering painting, carpet cleaning, flooring, remodeling, and make-ready unit services. One team handles every trade.

## Services

- Painting (interior, exterior, cabinet refinishing)
- Carpet Cleaning (deep clean, stain removal, pet treatment)
- Flooring (hardwood, LVP, tile installation)
- Remodeling (kitchens, bathrooms, full rooms)
- Make-Ready Units (rental turnovers, landlord services)

## Differentiator

One-stop shop: clients do not need to call separate vendors. One team handles every trade from start to finish, with one point of contact for decisions, updates, and invoicing.
